sources.title: Commissions — Futures (public pricing page)
sources.route: mcp web_reader (full render; prior session also used web_reader successfully)
extracted: US futures plan variants are two published columns: 'Tiered' and 'Fixed' (no separate Lite/Pro futures commission table appears in the fetched text; the Lite/Pro distinction does not alter the futures tier table on this page).

Tier table (United States, USD) verbatim: <=1,000 contracts/mo: Tiered USD 0.85/contract, Fixed USD 0.85/contract; 1,001-10,000: Tiered USD 0.65; 10,001-20,000: Tiered USD 0.45; >20,000: Tiered USD 0.25 (Fixed column publishes only the <=1,000 value, 0.85).
Plan add-on wording verbatim: Tiered = 'Exchange Fees + Regulatory Fees + Overnight Position Fees'; Fixed = 'Exchange Fees + Regulatory Fees'.
ES worked example (Tiered) verbatim: '1 ES Futures Contract = IBKR Execution Fee USD 0.85 + Exchange Fee USD 1.38 + Clearing Fee USD 0.00 + Regulatory Fee USD 0.00 = USD 2.24'.
ES worked example (Fixed) verbatim: '1 ES Futures Contract = IBKR Execution Fee USD 0.85 + Exchange Fee USD 1.38 + Clearing Fee USD 0.00 + Regulatory Fee USD 0.01 = USD 2.24'.

Footnote on tiers: monthly cumulative volume across all futures/FOPs regardless of exchange, applied marginally (verbatim: 'if in a given month, 1,000 contracts are traded and an additional 500 contracts are traded, the first 1,000 contracts would be charged at the USD 0.85 per contract rate and the following 500 contracts would be charged at the USD 0.65 per contract rate').

Footnote verbatim: tiered-plan offsets 'can be greater than costs paid by IBKR' ('IBKR is not a direct passthrough'); non-member exchange and regulatory fees are the ones applied unless customer pre-qualifies for member/incentive rates.
Rates changeable: 'IBKR may change these rates at any time in its sole discretion' (page notice).
limitations: Per-product exchange/regulatory fee tables and Overnight Position Fee amount tables on this page are JS-driven and did NOT render in either session (2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03): Overnight Position Fee amount = NOT_FETCHED.
No effective date line for the commission table rendered in the fetched text.
Printed tiered-example arithmetic: 0.85+1.38+0.00+0.00 sums to 2.23 but the page prints total USD 2.24; recorded as printed, discrepancy noted (possible rounding of a component).
